name: A-349821
summary: A-349,821 is a potent and selective histamine H3 receptor antagonist (or possibly an inverse agonist). It has nootropic effects in animal studies, although there do not appear to be any plans for clinical development at present and it is currently only used in laboratory research.

pharmacology.text: A-349,821 is a potent and selective histamine H3 receptor antagonist (or possibly an inverse agonist).

uses.text: It has nootropic effects in animal studies, although there do not appear to be any plans for clinical development at present and it is currently only used in laboratory research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory research compound and has not been tested in people, so its effects and risks are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室研究用化合物，未曾在人體測試，因此作用與風險都不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室研究用化合物，未曾在人体测试，因此作用与风险都不明。

fact.en: It blocks the histamine H3 receptor, which acts as a brake on the brain's own histamine release. Blocking the brake raises histamine signalling, which tends to promote wakefulness.
fact.zh: 它會阻斷組織胺H3受體，而這個受體的作用就像是腦中組織胺釋放的煞車。把煞車擋住，組織胺的訊息傳遞就會增強，通常會讓人更清醒。
fact.zhHans: 它会阻断组织胺H3受体，而这个受体的作用就像是脑中组织胺释放的煞车。把煞车挡住，组织胺的消息传递就会增强，通常会让人更清醒。
